svg.text: Debrief week 2: what worked, plan for Exp 2
Medium warmed, one vial per group at
hood with the group for the thaw.
Plates, scrapers. Look at every split
before it goes back in the incubator.
backup RAW on Wed 31 Mar, split Fri 2
Apr, so Exp 2 plates can be seeded
-80 freezer box per group; Mr Frosty
Exp 1 is a real experiment: four counts give a growth curve and a doubling time against the published value; viability of your own vial on Mon 5 Apr is
the second readout. Easter break Fri 26 Mar to Sun 4 Apr: no course, no cultures.
Facility slot: cytometer, facility lecture (fixed, reserved)
Wet lab Exp 1: establish the line (growth curve, freeze, re-thaw)
Wet lab Exp 2: polarize, challenge, read out
Dry lab and desk work: setup, analysis, planning
Poster and writing: introduction, significance, figures
